summary: Completed comprehensive testing of org-scoped broadcasts, scheduled exports, and user visibility features. All 15 backend tests passed. Frontend verified for both Org Admin and Super Admin views - org-scoped text displays correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/login for org admin returns organization_id and org_name in user object
Backend: POST /api/auth/login for org manager returns organization_id with role=Manager
Backend: POST /api/auth/login for org member returns organization_id with role=User
Backend: POST /api/auth/login for super admin has no organization_id and role=Super_Admin
Backend: GET /api/users with Super Admin auth returns ALL users (30+ users)
Backend: GET /api/users with Org Admin auth returns ONLY users from that admin's organization
Backend: POST /api/admin/broadcasts with Org Admin auth sends to org members only (3 recipients)
Backend: POST /api/admin/broadcasts with Super Admin auth sends to ALL users (32 recipients)
Backend: GET /api/admin/broadcasts with Org Admin auth only returns their org's broadcasts
Backend: GET /api/admin/broadcasts with Super Admin auth returns ALL broadcasts
Backend: GET /api/admin/scheduled-exports with Org Admin auth only returns their org's exports
Backend: POST /api/admin/scheduled-exports with Org Admin creates export with organization_id
Backend: POST /api/organizations/{org_id}/members with role=admin creates user with platform role=Admin
Backend: POST /api/organizations/{org_id}/members with role=manager creates user with platform role=Manager
Backend: POST /api/organizations/{org_id}/members with role=member creates user with platform role=User
Frontend: Org Admin login and navigate to Broadcasts page - text shows org name 'Munal Healthcare'
Frontend: Org Admin Broadcasts page header shows 'Send announcements to Munal Healthcare members'
Frontend: Org Admin Broadcasts tab shows 'Send messages to Munal Healthcare members'
Frontend: New Broadcast modal for Org Admin shows 'Send to Munal Healthcare' button
Frontend: New Broadcast modal for Org Admin shows 'This message will be sent to all members of Munal Healthcare'
Frontend: Super Admin Broadcasts page shows 'Send announcements to all users'
Frontend: Super Admin Broadcasts tab shows 'Send messages to all users at once'
Frontend: Super Admin broadcast modal shows 'Send to All Users' button
Frontend: Super Admin broadcast modal shows 'This message will be sent to all active users on the platform'
seed_data_creation: None - used existing org 'Munal Healthcare' with 3 members
context_for_next_testing_agent: Org-scoped broadcasts and exports feature fully tested. Key findings: (1) Org Admin/Manager broadcasts go to org members only (3 recipients for Munal Healthcare). (2) Super Admin broadcasts go to all users (32 recipients). (3) GET /api/users filters by caller's org for Admin/Manager. (4) Frontend correctly shows org name in Broadcasts page for Org Admin and 'all users' for Super Admin. (5) POST /api/organizations/{org_id}/members correctly maps org roles to platform roles (admin→Admin, manager→Manager, member→User). (6) Login returns organization_id and org_name for org users.

org_member_role_mapping.manager_org_role: Creates user with platform role=Manager, org_role=manager
org_member_role_mapping.member_org_role: Creates user with platform role=User, org_role=member
